'''2007 New Jersey State Championship Tom Schwarz LS An Unusual Amount Of Fear''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Schwarz]] at [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' ITTFYS(v) + EBO w0+
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
